finding: Several factors were identified as risk factors for ceasing exclusive breastfeeding early, including maternal non-exclusive breastfeeding intention, lower maternal educational level, mother-infant skin to skin contact over one hour, unsatisfied breastfeeding self-evaluation and maternal unhealthy condition within the first six weeks.
mod_finding: Mode of birth was not found to be a significant factor influencing exclusive breastfeeding duration in this study, as cases and controls were matched for mode of birth.
